1.1 WS2812 RGB LED

Controlling the WS2812 addressable RGB LED on the ESP32-S3 board.

Overview

This project demonstrates the simplest form of output: turning on an LED with different colors. The WS2812 is an addressable RGB LED that can display any color with a single GPIO pin.

What You’ll Learn

  • Using neopixelWrite() — the built-in ESP32 function for WS2812 control

  • RGB color model basics

  • Timing with delay()

Pin Connections

WS2812

ESP32-S3

Data

GPIO 48

VCC

5V

GND

GND

How the Code Works

The ESP32 Arduino core (v2.0.14+) includes a built-in neopixelWrite(pin, r, g, b) function that handles the WS2812 timing protocol — no external library is required.

// Set the LED to red
neopixelWrite(48, 255, 0, 0);

// Set to blue at half brightness
neopixelWrite(48, 0, 0, 128);

The demo cycles through six colors (Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Magenta) with a 1-second interval, then turns off. Brightness is scaled using a mapped value to avoid excessive power draw.

Expected Result

After uploading, the WS2812 LED cycles through six different colors, each displayed for approximately 1 second, then turns off.
